custom-house-plaza.commons: File:Custom House, Custom House Plaza, Monterey (Monterey County, California).jpg
custom-house-plaza.origin: Library of Congress, Historic American Buildings Survey, digital ID hhh.ca0380/photos.013690p
custom-house-plaza.author: Robert W. Kerrigan, Historic American Buildings Survey
custom-house-plaza.licenceNote: Work of the US federal government (HABS, National Park Service)
custom-house-plaza.alt: Black-and-white photograph of the Custom House in Monterey in 1936: a long whitewashed adobe with a tiled roof, a two-storey wooden balcony at the near end, and a vintage car parked along the street.
custom-house-plaza.caption: The Custom House beside Custom House Plaza, photographed in 1936 for the Historic American Buildings Survey.

point-pinos-lighthouse.origin: Wikimedia Commons, own work of the photographer
point-pinos-lighthouse.author: Daderot
point-pinos-lighthouse.licenceNote: Dedicated to the public domain by the photographer
point-pinos-lighthouse.alt: Point Pinos Lighthouse: a white keeper's house with a lantern tower rising from the roof, framed by wind-bent cypress trees, with the ocean behind a white rail fence.
point-pinos-lighthouse.caption: Point Pinos Lighthouse in Pacific Grove, photographed in 2012.

carmel-beach.origin: Wikimedia Commons, own work of the photographer
carmel-beach.author: Daderot
carmel-beach.licenceNote: Dedicated to the public domain by the photographer
carmel-beach.alt: White sand at Carmel Beach below a line of wind-shaped Monterey cypress trees and a weathered driftwood-grey cypress, under a sky of small clouds.
carmel-beach.caption: The sand and cypress at Carmel Beach, photographed in 2013 (cropped).
